purpose: Static scoped mutation fingerprints only; no grid or mutant execution
command:
import hashlib, importlib.util, json, re
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("registered_promisor_mutants", root / "tests/report-audit/promisor-mutants.py")
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
source = (root / "tools/report-landing-audit.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
source_digest = hashlib.sha256(source.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
ids = {"PM05-ignore-second-repo", "PM09-peel-bare-full-hash-lookup"}
rows = []
for mutant in mod.MUTANTS:
    if mutant["id"] not in ids:
        continue
    mutated, alternative = mod.apply_mutation(source, mutant)
    alt = mutant["alternatives"][alternative]
    count = source.count(alt["old"]) if alt["kind"] == "replace" else len(re.findall(alt["pattern"], source, re.DOTALL))
    rows.append({"mutant": mutant["id"], "applied_alternative": alternative, "selected_pattern_matches": count, "mutant_compiles": mod.compiles(mutated, mutant["id"]), "source_sha256": source_digest, "reconstructed_mutant_sha256": hashlib.sha256(mutated.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(), "note": "Static deterministic reproduction using pinned apply_mutation; ephemeral executed mutant file was not separately hashed."})
print(json.dumps({"static_only": True, "rows": rows}, indent=2))
